baseline.central14_ci_result: Go SUCCESS / Flutter SUCCESS / Compose SUCCESS / CENTRAL-14 runtime SUCCESS

requirements.requirement: Partners default screen renders from backend materialized hot snapshot and first usable data stays under 800 ms.
Filtered/search/paginated Partners views remain authoritative and permission-aware.
Licensing & Finance uses a materialized backend read model, bounded warm-up and sub-800 ms hot reads.
No infinite loading/retry loop when Finance or analytics data is absent/warming.
Package Analytics is backed by real Billing subscriptions, module usage and Portal activity, including authoritative package/partner counts.
Package Analytics includes the requested industry/category split.
requirements.finding: The analytics model has package counts, billing frequency, module usage and Portal activity, but no partner category/industry dimension or industry aggregate.

requirements.requirement: Partners PDF exporter shows an explicit no-exportable-data modal instead of downloading an empty PDF.
Packages PDF exporter shows an explicit no-exportable-data modal instead of downloading an empty PDF.
Licensing & Finance PDF exporter shows an explicit no-exportable-data modal instead of downloading an empty PDF.
Impact & Reports PDF exporter shows an explicit no-exportable-data modal instead of downloading an empty PDF.
Licensing & Finance operational invoice workflow remains functional: manual draft, approve, send, mark paid, cancel and invoice PDF.
Modules and Package definitions are not redesigned by CENTRAL-12.
Website & Marketing retains bilingual EN/HU labels and descriptions.
Design color labels are Primary Color, Brand Color, Page Background and Body Text Color.
Each color field exposes a visible color swatch/picker synchronized to HEX.
Heading and body font catalogs are expanded independently and backend validation accepts the same fonts.
Changing layout family changes presentation CSS without mutating CMS content/mechanical logic.
Backend generates real desktop/tablet/mobile previews at 1440x900, 834x1194 and 390x844.
The Design Guide shows an automatically loaded real website preview inside the editor, not only a schematic card/new-tab preview.
requirements.finding: The inline preview is a locally composed illustrative card. createPreview() opens the real backend preview in a new browser tab; it is not embedded/automatically loaded inside the Design Guide.

requirements.requirement: Publish Active Brand performs a real CMS publish and the public website uses the published design.
Klaviyo-specific top-level data connection is replaced by Partner Data Connections.
Partner connection cards show partner name, Active/Inactive/Suspended/Deleted state and runtime integration details.
Partner Data Connections uses compact responsive cards and real Connector/Website Adapter records without synthetic vendor rows.
Administration landing has exactly two main centers: HIMATE Administration Center and Partner Administration Center.
HIMATE center provides financial administration, corporate documents, governance/settings/access, audit/search and backup/recovery workspaces.
Partner center renders partner cards and tenant-scoped financial, documents, audit/log and backup/recovery workspaces.
Company and partner document registries are searchable server-side.
HIMATE platform has an enabled periodic encrypted backup policy and real restore verification.
Every partner receives periodic backup automatically without first requiring a manual backup or policy mutation.
requirements.finding: Scheduler iterates only existing backups.policies rows. Partner policy is created lazily by ensurePolicy() when a backup/policy call occurs; new partners are not automatically enrolled.

requirements.requirement: Verified partner production restore restores database, media, config and captured runtime release with safety backup, audit and rollback guards.
Operator can select either the latest or an earlier retained restore point for partner recovery.
requirements.finding: Backend GET /api/v1/backups?partner_id=... lists retained restore points, but the UI restore flow always reads latest_restore_point_id from summary and offers no restore-point history selector.

requirements.requirement: HIMATE platform itself can be restored to a retained restore point through a defined maintenance recovery procedure.
requirements.finding: Platform backup and restore-test exist, but production restore explicitly rejects _platform and the repository contains no separate platform maintenance restore script/runbook.

requirements.requirement: Restore operations are permission-gated and centrally audited.
Archive work is not pulled into CENTRAL-14 active operational scope.
CENTRAL-12/13/14 preserve backend-first domain ownership, microservice boundaries, containerized runtime acceptance and Flutter presentation-oriented architecture.
